'''Fia Mund''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kloo horn/Legends|Kloo horn]] player who was active during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Mund was regarded as one of the best new performing artists in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and on one occasion at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Mund gave a performance at the [[Rii Jenks Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]].
